purpose: Verify the frozen business-2 MCP worker runs independently on its required historical database schema; this is not a paired route result.

execution.environment: isolated disposable PostgreSQL test cluster; historical archive extracted to a temporary directory
execution.route: historical business-2 rule worker over MCP
execution.case_behavior: Creates two synthetic service tickets and verifies worker connection reuse and persisted history.

limitations: The current DecAgent schema-17 PlanRuntime route was not run in this same trial.
No normalized pre-execution state, identity/permission, tool-contract, or governance digest pair was produced.
This isolated smoke does not satisfy OpenSpec 9.6A and must not be reported as a fair paired comparison or public benchmark score.
